text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower's popularity has skyrocketed since the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But one day, Mihono Bourbon, who up until now has never had any issues despite her intense training, sustains an injury.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower spirals, thinking the injury is her fault because the two of them just became rivals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But when talking to Bourbon directly about the issue, she states definitively that the injury has nothing to do with Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Stunned by her words, Rice Shower is unable to say anything in reply.
